jobs.description: Job Posting: Since 1953, Ferguson has been a source of quality supplies for a variety of industries. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes and better businesses. We exist to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. We proactively solve problems, adapt and grow to continuously serve our customers, communities and each other. Ferguson, a Fortune 500 company, is proud to provide best-in-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in. Lead Backup & Recovery Engineer As a Lead Backup & Recovery Engineer, you will coordinate activities related to the enterprise data protection architecture for on-premises and cloud environments. You will set the technical direction for how the organization protects and recovers its data. You'll define backup policies, recovery objectives, and data lifecycle strategy in agreement with the business, establish the governance framework and standards the estate is held to, and own recoverability assurance. You'll own platform strategy and vendor selection end to end, and lead backup platform migrations including sequencing, risk position, and cutover authority. This is a technical leadership role rather than a day-to-day break-fix role; routine monitoring and first-line remediation sit with the operations team, while you own the architecture, standards, automation strategy, and final technical escalation above it. You'll present findings, risk positions, and program status to senior leadership, IT steering committees, and audit and risk functions, and defend architecture decisions under scrutiny. You'll set the capability development plan for engineers and operators and review the designs the team produces, while remaining hands-on enough to prototype new capability and lead the highest-risk implementation work personally. Location: This role is approved to be fully remote and can be based anywhere in the United States. Duties and Responsibilities: Own the enterprise data protection strategy and architecture across on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments. Define and maintain backup, retention, recovery, and data lifecycle standards, including RPO/RTO objectives aligned to business requirements. Design and implement resilient, ransomware-resistant backup and recovery solutions using immutable, air-gapped, and isolated recovery capabilities. Establish standard protection patterns for virtual, physical, database, containerized, SaaS, and cloud-native workloads. Lead evaluation, selection, implementation, migration, and lifecycle management of enterprise backup and recovery platforms. Develop disaster recovery architectures, replication strategies, failover/failback processes, and recovery testing programs that support business continuity objectives. Serve as the technical authority during disaster recovery exercises, audits, major incidents, and recovery events. Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, Storage, Database, and Application teams to ensure data protection requirements are incorporated into solution designs. Company Introduction
We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did we ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest-growing e-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.
We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.
Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.
Role Overview
The Commerce team is responsible for building next-generation cloud commerce systems that power pricing, billing, usage metering, and revenue generation for Coupang’s cloud platform. This team operates as the backbone of the cloud business, enabling accurate pricing, discounting, invoicing, and real-time usage visibility for customers.
The systems are highly scalable and event-driven, ingesting and processing massive volumes of data—including customer usage events and Kubernetes-driven infrastructure signals. As the platform scales from early-stage adoption to large-scale rollout, it is expected to handle exponentially growing workloads, potentially reaching hundreds of millions to billions of events, while maintaining high performance and reliability.
A key focus of this team is building financial-grade systems that ensure accuracy, consistency, and correctness in billing, pricing, and revenue computation. These systems must provide real-time insights to customers while guaranteeing precise accounting of usage and charges.
As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will act as a technical leader, translating complex business requirements into scalable architecture and distributed systems. You will design and build low-latency, high-throughput backend services that can support multi-tenant cloud environments, ensure reliability under rapid growth, and maintain strict correctness in revenue-critical workflows.
What You Will Do
Design and build scalable backend systems for pricing, billing, and usage metering
Develop event-driven architectures to process large volumes of real-time usage and infrastructure data
Build systems that provide real-time visibility into customer usage and billing metrics
Design components for rate cards, pricing plans, discounting, and multi-currency transactions
Work on distributed systems that support exponential growth in customers and usage events
Collaborate with product, infrastructure, and platform teams to build cloud-native commerce capabilities
Ensure high levels of accuracy, reliability, and scalability in revenue-critical systems
Contribute to architecture decisions and drive engineering best practices
Basic Qualifications
8+ years of backend engineering experience
Strong proficiency in Java-based backend development
Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
Experience building event-driven architectures and distributed systems
Experience designing and scaling high-throughput systems handling large volumes of events
Experience working with AWS-managed databases (e.g., Aurora or similar OLTP systems)
Familiarity with containerized systems and Kubernetes ecosystems
Experience building real-time systems (e.g., usage tracking, billing, metering pipelines)
Strong understanding of system design, scalability, and reliability principles
Strong problem-solving skills with focus on efficiency and correctness
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Golang for backend development
Deep expertise in AWS ecosystem (compute, storage, distributed services)
Experience designing large-scale event processing systems (hundreds of millions to billions of events)
Experience building cloud commerce platforms, billing systems, or pricing engines
Familiarity with real-time usage metering, invoicing, or revenue systems
Experience working with Kubernetes-based observability signals (logs, infra events, metrics)
Exposure to high-growth systems scaling from early stage to large production scale
Experience building multi-tenant, customer-facing cloud platforms
Type of work model
Hybrid / Onsite / Remote working
Our Hybrid work model: Coupang hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration that acts a catalyst to enrich the experience of employees. Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work.

jobs.description: We are seeking a Principal Product Manager - Technical to own the post-purchase experience for Alexa for Shopping (formerly Rufus), the conversational shopping AI used by hundreds of millions of customers every month. You will own the surfaces where product ownership happens today, from Your Orders to the returns flow, and turn each completed purchase into the beginning of the next mission. You will partner closely with multiple engineering and science teams, as well as the Delivery Experience, Customer Service, and Selling Partner organizations whose data and workflows the experience depends on, and will drive the cross-organizational decisions to define and influence the future of shopping AI. Every month, hundreds of millions of customers use Alexa for Shopping to help with shopping decisions. We are building a conversational shopping experience that understands what customers need, provides trustworthy and helpful responses, and makes the entire shopping journey effortless. jobs.description: Position Overview: The Principal Solution Architect, Data is responsible for defining, scaling, and governing enterprise-wide or business solution architecture across platforms, domains, and delivery teams. This role shapes how technology solutions are designed, integrated, secured, and operated consistently across the organization. While architecture is foundational, the Principal Solution Architect, Data will be responsible for designing solutions in close collaboration with the business and technology stakeholders. Where applicable, the role will be accountable to build solutions that scale and align to business and technology requirements. Operating at an enterprise or portfolio level, the Principal Solution Architect, Data focuses less on individual solution delivery and more on establishing architecture patterns, standards, guardrails, and building solutions that enable teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, and secure solutions at speed. This role operates within a federated Enterprise Architecture (EA) model, partnering closely with business technology and platform teams to shape solutions in real time while improving accountability, speed, and delivery alignment. The architect remains connected to the central EA core through enterprise standards, governance, communities of practice, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure consistent, risk-aware technology decisions across domains. This role partners closely with Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Product, Cybersecurity, and Platform teams to ensure solutions align to business strategy, are resilient and compliant, and can scale across multiple use cases without becoming a bottleneck to delivery. This Principal Solution Architect, Data role will have a strong focus on data solution architecture, modern data platforms, data products, and AI-enabled capabilities across the Insurance business. The role bridges business, engineering, architecture, and data teams to rapidly design, build, and deploy scalable solutions that improve underwriting, enrollment, billing, claims, customer service, Producer, reporting, analytics, and digital experiences. The architect will champion a data product mindset, treating data as a strategic enterprise asset with clear ownership, quality standards, reusable capabilities, governance, and measurable customer value. Key Responsibilities: Own and shape enterprise or business solution architecture strategy, standards, and patterns across multiple platforms and domains. Define and maintain reference architectures and reusable design patterns (“golden paths”) for solution delivery. Establish architectural guardrails that enable scalable, secure, and consistent solution design across teams. Own reusable solution patterns, reference architectures, golden paths, and cross-team design consistency. Work with Solution Architects to drive adoption; Head of Portfolio Architecture to tailor for BU context; Principal Enterprise Architect to align with enterprise standards. Lead enterprise-level or business-level design decisions for complex, high-impact initiatives that span multiple value streams or business units. Provide architectural oversight and guidance across portfolios, ensuring alignment to enterprise standards and long-term strategy. Drive early engagement on initiatives to identify cross-platform dependencies, systemic risks, and scalability constraints. Partner with Enterprise Architecture and platform teams to define build vs. buy guidance and integration patterns. Translate business and technology strategy into actionable architecture direction and solution designs. Partner with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to embed governance, security, and regulatory requirements into solution architecture. Define and promote best practices for operational resilience, scalability, performance, and maintainability. Escalate enterprise exceptions, non-standard patterns, and enterprise-risk decisions. Influence and align stakeholders across engineering, product, and business leadership without direct authority. Mentor and coach architects and senior engineers to elevate architectural maturity across the organization. Represent solution architecture in enterprise forums, architecture review boards, and strategic technology discussions. Influence Value Stream leaders, Product Managers, Product Owners, and Tech Leads to align roadmaps, MVP scope, and technical trade-offs. Where applicable, the role will be accountable to build solutions that scale and algin to business and technology requirements. Be available for production incidents with major impact to business operations. Understand and participate across portfolio initiatives, connect dependencies and opportunities across programs to optimize solutions, increase reuse, and reduce data waste. Drive the adoption of a data product operating model across the organization. Champion data product thinking by promoting customer-centric design, product ownership, continuous improvement, and measurable business value. Establish best practices for discoverability, usability, interoperability, governance, and consumption of enterprise data products. Translate business strategy into scalable technology, data, and analytics solutions. Lead discovery workshops and data solution design sessions across underwriting, enrollment, billing, claims, customer service, reporting, and digital channels. Influence enterprise technology strategy by identifying reusable capabilities and modernization opportunities. Develop reusable frameworks, accelerators, and reference architectures to improve data delivery speed, consistency, and reuse. Design modern data platforms and pipelines that support real-time and batch processing, scalable data integration, and enterprise analytics needs. Ensure high-quality, trusted data through governance, observability, lineage, metadata, and automated data quality controls. Collaborate with data engineering, product, and AI teams to operationalize AI-enabled data solutions within the data ecosystem. Foster collaboration across architecture, engineering, product management, security, data, AI, and business teams. You Have (Required Skills): Deep experience designing and governing enterprise-scale solution architectures across multiple teams and domains. Proven ability to define and drive adoption of architecture standards, frameworks, and reusable patterns. Strong understanding of modern technology ecosystems, including application architectures, APIs and delivery, integration patterns, AI, cloud platforms, and data flows. Experience balancing business priorities, technical trade-offs, and risk at an enterprise level. Demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels when needed. Strong experience influencing technical direction across distributed teams without direct reporting authority. Ability to bridge business and technology, translating strategy into clear architectural direction. Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience working in regulated or risk-sensitive environments with strong awareness of governance and compliance needs. Track record of mentoring architects and engineers and elevating organizational capabilities. Experience collaborating within Agile / product-based delivery models. Experience producing product-level and team-level technical design documentation. Additional Required Data-Focused Qualifications: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 15+ years of experience in data integration, data architecture, data modeling, data engineering, solution architecture, or enterprise technology. Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, data products, or analytics capabilities. Strong understanding of modern data architecture principles, including data mesh, data products, metadata, governance, and domain-driven design. Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Kafka, or similar technologies. Experience rolling out AI capabilities or AI-enabled solutions within a data ecosystem. Experience within insurance industry, including enrollment, eligibility, policy administration, billing, claims, customer data, and employer administration. Expertise in cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. Strong programming and data engineering skills in Python, PySpark, and SQL. Exceptional communication, executive presence, and stakeholder management skills. Experience leading data product initiatives, including proof-of-concept development and feasibility assessment. Familiarity with product management methodologies and Agile frameworks. Success Measures: Increased adoption and reuse of enterprise data products. Improved business outcomes through product-driven data capabilities. Faster delivery of business initiatives through reusable platforms and engineering accelerators. Increased adoption of AI-powered solutions across organization. Higher data quality, trust, discoverability, and governance. Strong cross-functional alignment between business, product, engineering, architecture, and data organizations. Working independently, you will convert high level concepts down to tangible specifications that can be implemented efficiently. You should enjoy collaborating with engineers with their diverse skillsets and bring their expertise to bear on solving challenging Programable Clock problems. Large Scale Block to Block Clock timing analysis, within the Die & Die to Die Clock interposer crossing. Deep analysis of timing paths to identify and debug key issues. Familiarity with test, debug, yield, post-Silicon Validation & Characterization is a plus. Working experience of Package level Clock SIPI is a plus.
